title: Parameter
description: Defines a user-configurable input parameter for an application.

type.description: Data type of the parameter value.

items.description: Element schema. Required when type is 'array', forbidden otherwise.

title.description: Display label shown in the UI.

description.description: Help text shown below the field.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled.

sensitive.description: Marks the parameter as secret. The value is sealed for the target TEE, masked in the UI, automatically stripped from the deployment evidence snapshot (recorded as a hidden field), and may only surface through outputs of type 'secret'.

generated.description: If true and the user leaves the field blank, the platform generates a cryptographically random value. Only valid for sensitive string parameters.

immutable.description: If true, the value cannot be changed when reconfiguring an existing deployment.

default.description: Default value. Must match the declared type; for type 'array' it is a JSON array whose elements match 'items.type' and are drawn from 'options'.

allOf.description: 'items' and 'options' are required for array parameters and 'items' is forbidden elsewhere; arrays default to a list and cannot be sensitive or generated.

pattern.description: Regex pattern the string value must match.

minItems.description: Minimum number of selected elements for array types.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of selected elements for array types.
